Spa Manager

Comis Hotel & Golf Resort is seeking an experienced and commercially focused Spa Manager to lead our spa operation and deliver an exceptional guest experience. This is a hands-on role combining spa management with treatment delivery.

Key responsibilities include managing daily spa operations, leading and developing the spa team, delivering treatments, overseeing bookings and rotas, driving retail and revenue performance, maintaining high presentation standards, and supporting the spa’s social media presence.

The ideal candidate will hold NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent), have previous spa supervisory or management experience, strong treatment skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for guest care and wellness. Knowledge of Elemis products would be an advantage.

The role requires flexibility, including weekends and busy operational periods.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary dependent on experience
• Staff benefits and hotel discounts
• Service charge participation
• Free onsite parking
• Training and development opportunities
• Supportive working environment within a growing resort

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to:
HR@comishotel.com

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Notes
We are looking for a reliable and hardworking Commercial Window Cleaner to join our team. This full-time role involves cleaning windows across a variety of commercial buildings and sites, including high-level windows using access equipment. The successful candidate will also provide relief cover for our trailer driver when required.
The role requires an individual who is physically fit, safety-conscious, and capable of working independently while maintaining high standards of workmanship. Duties include cleaning external windows to a professional standard, operating hoist/cherry picker equipment and other access equipment for high-rise buildings, ensuring all work is carried out in accordance with health and safety procedures, reporting any defects or issues identified during cleaning operations, and completing assigned sites within scheduled timeframes.
Applicants must hold a full driving licence and be able to work the required hours of 4:00am to 12:00pm, Monday to Friday. Candidates must be physically fit, comfortable working at heights, and capable of using access equipment safely. Reliability, punctuality, attention to detail, and a positive attitude are essential, along with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

This a full-time permanent position with a consistent 40-hour working week, training and support where required, and the opportunity to work within a professional and supportive team environment.

If you are dependable, motivated, and looking for a rewarding role in a growing business, we would like to hear from you.

To apply, please send your CV and covering letter to hr@prospero.im

Our client is seeking a Compliance Officer to support governance, regulatory compliance, and risk management across the business. Reporting to the eGaming Compliance Manager, the role involves overseeing client compliance obligations, ensuring regulatory deadlines are met, and identifying and escalating risks in line with Company procedures.
Key responsibilities include supporting gambling licence applications, onboarding, client reviews, SAR submissions, AML/CFT monitoring, and ensuring compliance with GSC returns and wider regulatory requirements. The role may also involve holding approved regulatory positions such as AML/CFT Compliance Officer and MLRO, while providing guidance to internal teams and clients on compliance matters.
You will assist with regulatory inspections, policy development, and maintaining strong relationships with regulators and stakeholders, while also mentoring junior team members and supporting team development.
The ideal candidate will have strong compliance experience, preferably within eGaming, financial services, or fiduciary services, with a solid understanding of AML/CFT legislation, Isle of Man regulatory requirements, and risk management. Strong communication, organisation, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with a proactive and detail-focused approach. Register your interest by emailing jobs@bespoke.co.im or via our website www.bespoke.co.im/contact

Notes
Altenar is a leading sportsbook software provider delivering flexible, fully managed solutions to gaming operators globally. With a strong track record of growth and innovation, we operate at the intersection of technology and gaming.

We are looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join our in-house team with strong communication skills. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of legal matters, work closely with the business, and play a hands-on role in shaping how legal supports a growing international company. 

This position is suited to a proactive and detail-oriented lawyer who is comfortable working independently, taking accountability, and driving continuous improvement in legal processes and documentation.

Key responsibilities:

Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS/software licensing, partnerships, and supplier contracts.
Act as a key legal contact for business stakeholders, providing clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused advice.
Take ownership of legal support for designated business areas.
Identify and implement improvements to legal processes, workflows, and ways of working.
Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance.
Collaborate with a multi-jurisdictional legal team.
Manage external counsel and support disputes where required.
Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments in the gaming and technology sectors.
Support strategic business initiatives, including new product development.

Skills & Experience:

4-6 years PQE (post qualification experience).
as a solicitor, advocate or equivalent required – this is a guideline so if you feel that you are suitable, please still apply.
Strong grounding in commercial and contract law. 
Experience in the gaming industry/software development industry is advantageous but not essential.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage priorities. 
Experience improving legal processes, templates, or ways of working is highly desirable. 
Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
Ability to provide practical, business-focused advice in a clear and concise manner.
Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively across different jurisdictions and cultures.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and interest in the gaming/technology space.

Legal Technology & Innovation:

Experience working with legal technology tools (e.g. CLM systems, document automation) is advantageous.
Interest in leveraging AI and legal technology to improve legal service delivery and efficiency is desirable. 

Benefits:

Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Discretionary bonus linked to performance.
Stable and flexible working environment.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
International, collaborative team environment.
Varied and  engaging work.

For more details and to apply contact job@altenar.com

Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Ensure Player Safety:
Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Work with the Officiating Team:
Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Manage Player and Team Conduct:
Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Apply Match Procedures:
Conduct pre-match checks (pitch, equipment, players), manage substitutions, keep time, and restart play correctly.

Report and Administration:
Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Work with the Officiating Team:
Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Manage Player and Team Conduct:
Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Apply Match Procedures:
Conduct pre-match checks (pitch, equipment, players), manage substitutions, keep time, and restart play correctly.

Report and Administration:
Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

For more details and to apply contact Referee@isleofmanfa.com or 01624649394

Notes
Delivery Driver's play a crucial part of the team within GSF Car Parts. They are the face of our brand by delivering parts to customers and continuously providing excellent customer service. Our Delivery Drivers are important to us, giving customer feedback insights and ensuring we stay committed to delivering goods within the promised time. 
 
As a Delivery Driver, you will be responsible for contributing to overall success of a high performing organisation and promoting the Company brand through positive interaction with customers.

Main Duties include:

Delivering product to customer’s premises within a 40 mile radius.
Ensure high levels of customer service at all times.
Feedback to branch on relevant customer and competitor activity.
Load your vehicle according to procedures.
Collect customer returns as required.
Vehicle maintenance including carrying out daily checks.
Help in the warehouse as and when required.
Assist with Inter-Branch Transfer Deliveries as and when required.
Working hours:

41 (average) hours Monday to Friday, including alternate Saturday working.

What you'll need to succeed:

Must hold a full UK Driving Licence with a maximum of 6 points.
Must have a minimum of 3 years driving experience.
Excellent knowledge of 40 mile radius of branch.
Previous experience within a delivery driver role.
Ability to understand necessity of excellent standards of customer service.
Work to deadlines with good time keeping skills.
Customer focused, driven to achieve and willing to go the extra mile.
What we'll offer:

Benefits at GSF Car Parts are designed to support all aspects of our team members life throughout their career. Whether that’s their health, wealth or everyday lifestyle, we are here for our team members and their loved ones and there is something for everyone! To name a few of our benefits we offer:

28 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus the opportunity to earn up to 5 more with time-served.
Free flu vaccine.
Health & wellbeing tools.
Free support from pension experts .
Life assurance scheme.
Discounts from 100’s of household names including Asda, Nike & John Lewis.
A suite of financial wellbeing products including advances and savings schemes. 
Paid time off to volunteer.
Training qualifications and career progression opportunities.

For more details and to apply contact brian.clarke@gsfgroup.com

Key Responsibilities
As a Delivery Driver and Warehouse Operative at Pacesetter, you will be primarily responsible for delivering orders to sites across the Isle of Man in a timely and professional manner. You will plan and organise your delivery routes efficiently to make the most of each working day, and ensure that all deliveries are correct and complete against the relevant paperwork. Back at the warehouse, you will unload incoming stock, inspect items for damage and allocate them to the correct orders, as well as providing general support across warehouse operations as needed.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must be aged 18 or over and hold a full driving licence, as this is central to the role. We are looking for someone with a positive work history and a strong record of reliable attendance. While not essential, knowledge of tiles or bathroom materials would be an advantage, as would holding a forklift licence. Above all, we are looking for someone dependable, organised and happy to turn their hand to whatever the day requires.

How to Apply
To find out more or to apply, please contact us by phone on 01624 622045 or by email at dan@pacesetter-ltd.com. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Notes
The Exam Invigilator supervises candidates during examinations at the ExamSpace centre, ensuring each session runs smoothly, securely and exactly in line with the relevant awarding body’s instructions, and that all candidates are treated fairly and professionally.

The role includes preparing the examination room before each session, including checking seating, equipment, materials and signage; verifying candidate identity and confirming attendance registers on arrival; performing security checks on candidates; briefing candidates clearly on examination rules and procedures; supervising candidates attentively throughout the examination (walk arounds and via CCTV) and remaining vigilant at all times; starting, timing and ending examinations precisely in accordance with awarding body instructions; operating examination delivery software on a Windows PC and dealing calmly with any issues that arise (with the support of other members of staff); responding to candidate queries and incidents in a calm, professional manner, escalating where necessary; recording and reporting any irregularities, suspected malpractice or incidents accurately; maintaining the security and confidentiality of examination materials and candidate data before, during and after each session; and restoring the examination room to readiness after each session.

Duties and responsibilities will evolve as ExamSpace grows and as further awarding bodies are added. The job description will be updated as the role develops.

Full training will be provided. Before invigilating for any awarding body, the role holder must complete that body’s own online invigilator training and assessment. A separate, straightforward assessment is required for each awarding body, these are not difficult, but they must be completed and kept up to date.

There are no minimum formal qualifications for this role. The following attributes are essential:
A reliable, punctual and trustworthy approach; confidence using a Windows PC; strong people skills, with a calm, professional and approachable manner; excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow detailed written instructions precisely; discretion and an understanding of the importance of confidentiality and examination security; and flexibility and good availability during weekday office hours.

Additionally, experience in exam invigilation (paper or computer based) would be advantageous.

This is a zero-hours contract; work is offered on an as-required basis and is not guaranteed.

Examinations are scheduled within office hours, Monday to Friday.  Depending upon the examination the exam centre may need to be open 08.15 – 18.00.

At least approximately 30 examination days per year are currently anticipated for one awarding body, with additional days expected as further awarding bodies are contracted.  A number of contracts are currently under discussion.

Based at ExamSpace, Winchester Court, Second Avenue, Onchan.

For more details and to apply contact leslie.foster@governancepeople.com or 07624 200355.

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team.

The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times.

Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 2 and 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position.

Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities.

Why Join Prospero Group?

We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave.  Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us.

To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Swagelok Ltd. 
Tool Maker.
We are Hiring!
We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift.
Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday).
Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding).
We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.
The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience:
Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements:
Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You:
This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.
To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Notes
Our client seeks a Reconciliations Manager to join their team. Role Profile: Lead a team to ensure that all critical financial reconciliations within the Group is done in a timely, accurate and in accord with accounting standards. In addition, to provide assistance to the subsidiaries in regard to management information and analysis. Key Responsibilities: Overseeing a team, including collaborating with key stakeholders outside of the Finance department, to ensure effective resolution of reconciling items. This includes: IT and Operations, liaising with third party suppliers and finance teams across the Group. Producing balance sheet reconciliations and ensuring unusual discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner or escalated to senior management, as applicable. Contributing to and leading the launch of new automated initiatives, including purchase and sales ledger systems, RPAs, data-analysis tools. Compiling, maintaining and updating the reconciliation matrix to ensure that all critical reconciliations are identified and performed in the Group. Reviewing reconciliations prepared by others, querying the allocation and posting of outstanding and reconciled items. Training members within the team, upskilling individuals to develop their reconciliation skills. Adhering to the month-end timetable to ensure that reconciliations are completed by. Journal posting and month-end reporting activities. Ensuring compliance with internal controls and applicable accounting framework. Processing and timely release of electronic payments whilst ensuring payment release controls are maintained. Participating in adhoc projects as required. Maintain awareness and comply with all anti-money laundering legislation, regulations, policies and procedures relevant to the Group. Comply with all policies and procedures relevant to the role. Key Skills and Experience: Part qualified accountant or actively studying towards an accounting qualification or previous relevant work experience. Excellent excel and numeracy skills. Attention to detail. Excellent communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Knowledge of ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero).
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16537

Our client seeks a Tax Associate to join their team. As a Tax Associate, you'll be part of a dynamic team providing high-quality tax services to a diverse client portfolio. From day one, you'll have direct client exposure and work across all aspects of tax compliance and advisory services for both Isle of Man and UK jurisdictions. This role offers comprehensive training in corporate and personal tax returns, VAT compliance, and technical research while working towards a recognised tax qualification. Communicate with clients to request information and provide updates. Draft application forms for submission to ITD or HMRC. Collaborate with internal teams on client onboarding processes. Update internal reporting systems for client deliverables. Stay current with tax developments through various sources. Support the team with additional administrative tasks as required. Key Skills & Experience: Strong academic background with commitment to studying towards a recognised tax qualification. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Assertive and confident approach to learning complex technical processes. Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment. Previous tax-related experience and workplace experience in different environments. The ability to work independently but also thrive in a team.

Our client seeks a Client Accountant to join their team. In this role, you'll manage a diverse portfolio of entities, preparing financial statements and providing expert accounting services. Working with complex multi-currency transactions and sophisticated structures, you'll play a vital role in delivering exceptional client service while developing your expertise in this dynamic sector. Key Responsibilities: Manage the recording of financial information and preparation of financial statements for an allocated portfolio of entities. Maintain accurate day-to-day client ledgers, ensuring all transactions align with source documentation for complex multi-currency transactions. Keep up-to-date accounting records for client entities, paying attention to bank statements, agreements, invoices, and contracts. Liaise with the Administration Team on accounting queries and provide technical assistance as required. Prepare annual financial statements, solvency tests, asset statements, and other ad-hoc financial reporting. Prepare tax returns including UK property holdings with HMRC, IOM tax returns, and other relevant jurisdictional filings. Maintain awareness of changes to relevant financial, legal, and regulatory frameworks. Meet internal deadlines while maintaining high attention to detail and accuracy across all client financial records. Update accounts monitoring systems and maintain comprehensive documentation. Key Skills and Experience: A relevant qualification (e.g., ACCA) or minimum of 3 years' experience in a similar role. Preferably fiduciary experience of accounting for company and trust structures. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written. Enquiring mind with ability to question, research, apply, and share learning. High level of accuracy, initiative, and exceptional organisational skills. Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel to intermediate or higher level. Ability to pick up and adapt to various bespoke IT/accounting systems and banking platforms. Excellent organisational skills and ability to meet tight deadlines. Ability to work under pressure and deal with complex issues proactively. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16509

Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
Proven bookkeeping experience .
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Proficiency in Quickbooks would be an advantage, but not essential.

Part-time hours: we are looking for someone to work 25-30 hours per week (typically between 9.30am-3.30pm Monday to Friday).
Competitive remuneration package including free parking and non-contributory pension scheme.

Interested?
Please send your CV and a cover email addressed to Fiona at hr@trilogy.im

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and colleagues. Experience in a Big 4 environment is advantageous but not essential.

Notes
We are looking for an experienced trust professional, or qualified accountant, to join our Family Office Relationship Management team at Stonehage Fleming. This position reports into Head of Family Office Isle of Man, but the successful individual may also work for more than one Director and/or Partner within the department. This varied role involves close and regular interaction with clients and third parties of the Stonehage Fleming Group as well as with internal departments and business units.
The successful candidate will be expected to:
Build and maintain long term relationships with clients which includes all forms of contact/communication with clients and their advisers.
Develop and maintain relationships with internal departments/business divisions of the Group to effectively manage the clients’ affairs.
Support the business development/marketing efforts of the Group.
Consult with third party professionals such as lawyers, tax specialists and asset managers, and obtain their opinions pertaining to the management of the clients’ affairs.
Run clients’ affairs including preparing meeting documents, analysing performance of investments, valuing investments; analysing costs.
Ensure all transactions pertaining to the management of the clients’ affairs are executed timely, efficiently and accounted for correctly.
Obtain in-depth knowledge of our clients, their businesses and the family dynamics, maintain the client file with meeting notes, becoming familiar with the trust deed and entity structures.
Approve payments, cash management, forex transactions.
Review financial statements of client entities.
Renegotiate existing loans with banks, negotiate new loans with banks.
Review contracts between client entities and third parties.
Share and develop expertise and provide team members with technical assistance on complex documentation, including reviewing and drafting where necessary.
Understand and manage risk involved in administering structures ensuring internal procedures are adhered to and maintained.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:
Educated to degree level (or equivalent).
Relevant Professional qualification (e.g STEP, ACCA etc.).
1 – 3 years relevant post-qualification experience.
SA Tax experience would be an advantage.

For more information and to apply visit: www.stonehagefleming.com

Notes
Salary up to £75,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 plus Relocation Allowance up to £5,000.

Are you looking for an equine-focused role that offers genuine professional fulfilment alongside an exceptional quality of life? We’re delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for an Equine Veterinary Surgeon to join our thriving practice on the beautiful Isle of Man. This is a varied and rewarding equine-only position, working within a supportive and experienced team where you’ll be encouraged to develop your clinical skills while enjoying a truly unique island lifestyle. For those considering relocation, we offer full support with moving to the Isle of Man, helping to make the transition as smooth and stress-free as possible so you can focus on settling into both your new role and your new home.

Looking for a better work–life balance?

We offer a genuinely flexible approach to working patterns and welcome both full-time and part-time applicants. The full-time role is 38 hours per week, worked over 4 or 5 days, with 1 in 4 Saturday mornings and approximately 1 in 10 nights and weekends on call. Work–life balance is a genuine priority here. You’ll benefit from a competitive salary, generous holiday allowance, and strong CPD support to help you continue developing your equine interests and expertise. Our flexible rota patterns are designed to work around real life — whether that’s school commitments, reduced hours during holidays, or a working pattern that better suits your lifestyle, we’re happy to fix or flex rotas wherever possible. 

Team & Facilities:

You’ll be joining a supportive, friendly and experienced team that values collaboration, mentorship, and a positive working culture. The wider clinical team includes 17 Veterinary Surgeons, 14 Registered Veterinary Nurses, and 20 dedicated support staff, with BVRA-registered members and certificate holders within the group. This equine-only role offers a varied and rewarding caseload, combining ambulatory work in the field with access to excellent facilities and modern diagnostic equipment, enabling you to practice high-quality, progressive equine medicine. You’ll be supported by a knowledgeable team and a learning-focused environment where professional development is actively encouraged and your ideas are valued.

Life on the Isle of Man:

Set against a backdrop of rolling hills, rugged coastlines, and open countryside, the Isle of Man offers a truly special way of life. You’ll become part of a welcoming, close-knit community with a vibrant cultural scene — from the world-famous TT races and music festivals to live shows, local breweries, and a thriving food scene. With endless opportunities for outdoor pursuits, including equestrian activities, cycling, wild swimming, and fitness, it’s easy to build a life here that’s as fulfilling outside of work as it is within it.

Apply via the IVC website or contact taylor.findlay@ivcevidensia.com

Join Woodbourne Dental, an established and highly regarded mixed practice on the Isle of Man. We are offering an exciting opportunity for an Associate Dentist to take over an existing, well-established patient list from our Principal Dentist, who is looking to move to a part-time oversight role. This transition promises a seamless handover and a steady flow of loyal patients, ensuring the new Associate can hit the ground running with a high potential for earnings.

Our Practice Offers:

Market-leading UDA rates, with up to 6,000 UDAs available.
Hand-over of the Principal Dentist's patients, providing an opportunity to hit the ground running with an established patient base.
Significant private treatment income opportunities from a vast number of long-standing patients with a high re-attendance rate across pay-as-you-go and Denplan patients.
A modern, fully digitised practice and state-of-the-art dental technology, including oral scanners.

Notes
Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

Notes
Are you looking to start a rewarding career in healthcare? Port Erin Dental Surgery is seeking a friendly, motivated and reliable Trainee Dental Nurse to join our growing team.

No previous dental experience is required. We will provide comprehensive in-house training and support while you complete the 2-year Dental Nursing Diploma course through Isle of Man College, leading to a recognised qualification and professional registration as a Dental Nurse.

About the Role

As a Trainee Dental Nurse, you will work closely with our dentists, hygienists and experienced nursing team, learning all aspects of dental nursing while helping to deliver excellent patient care.

Duties will include:

Assisting dentists during a variety of dental procedures.
Preparing treatment rooms and equipment.
Cleaning, sterilising and maintaining instruments.
Supporting and reassuring patients throughout their treatment.
Maintaining accurate patient records.
Following infection prevention and control procedures.
Managing stock and supplies.
Assisting with reception duties when required.

What We’re Looking For:

Friendly and professional attitude.
Excellent communication skills.
Reliable, punctual and well organised.
Positive approach to learning.
Ability to work well as part of a team.
Caring and compassionate nature.
GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths are desirable.

What We Offer:

Full in-house training and mentoring
Support to complete the 2-year Dental Nursing Diploma at Isle of Man College
A friendly and supportive working environment
Opportunity to develop a long-term career within dentistry
Ongoing professional development
Employee dental benefits

For more details and to apply contact claire_015@hotmail.co.uk

We have an excellent opportunity for a qualified Part Time Dispenser/Trainee Dispenser to work in our Castletown branch. Working 12 hours per week, from 11.00am to 5.30pm Thursday and Friday each week. Additional hours may be required from time to time and applicants must be fully flexible to work according to the rota.

Working as part of a team duties can include; sales of over the counter medicines, providing customers with information on symptoms and products, prescription receipt and collection, date checking, and the ordering, receiving and storing of pharmaceutical stock.  Applicants must have excellent communication skills and have the ability to work accurately with attention to detail.

Essential Criteria:
Hold NPA Accredited Assistants course or equivalent NVQ Level II in Pharmacy Services.
Previous relevant dispensary experience.
Flexible to work according to the rota.
Team worker.
Excellent customer service skills.
Must be prepared to complete further training within the pharmacy.

Join Woodbourne Dental, an established and highly regarded mixed practice on the Isle of Man. We are offering an exciting opportunity for an Associate Dentist to take over an existing, well-established patient list from our Principal Dentist, who is looking to move to a part-time oversight role. This transition promises a seamless handover and a steady flow of loyal patients, ensuring the new Associate can hit the ground running with a high potential for earnings.

Our Practice Offers:

Market-leading UDA rates, with up to 6,000 UDAs available.
Hand-over of the Principal Dentist's patients, providing an opportunity to hit the ground running with an established patient base.
Significant private treatment income opportunities from a vast number of long-standing patients with a high re-attendance rate across pay-as-you-go and Denplan patients.
A modern, fully digitised practice and state-of-the-art dental technology, including oral scanners.
Benefits:

Exceptional work-life balance in the Isle of Man, known for its stunning countryside, coastlines, and safe, vibrant community.
Extremely low income tax rates, enhancing your take-home pay.
Opportunities for both experienced clinicians and recently qualified dentists to grow and excel.
A professional yet friendly team environment with experienced staff.
Requirements:

GDC registration.
Active NHS performer number or eligibility to obtain one.
Strong commitment to quality patient care and excellent communication skills.
Ability to reliably commute to the practice or relocate to Isle of Man.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Company events.
On-site parking.

GDC registration (ESSENTIAL).

Notes
Senior support worker:
The purpose of the role is to guide and support the support worker team to meet the needs of the individual service user while promoting and maintaining independence and ensuring all duties are carried out in a person-centred way. To support the team, modelling good practice and promoting positive attitudes. To support the management to meet excellent standards of care delivery.
Supporting people in various areas of identified need, including; Mental Health, wellbeing and emotions, Physical health, medication needs, hygiene routine, communication, daily living skills, quality of life and activities, relationships, education and employment, finances and budgets, dependency needs, community safety, legal matters and housing support. Staff must be motivated, sensible, flexible in their ways of working and have empathy for others. 
The Senior Support worker should have/or be completing Level 3 RQF in health and social care (or equivalent) and 2 years’ experience working with people with complex needs. Applicants who have level 2 RQF and more than 3 years’ experience may also be considered.
The service works on a shift basis with occasional sleep-in shifts and weekend work. Sleep-in shifts are paid additionally at £50 per night. 
Typical hours may include: 
Early day = 08:00 - 16:00. 
Late day = 12:00 – 20:00
Late sleep and early = 12:00 – 22:00 – sleep-in, then 08:00 – 13:00. 

We can offer, contracted 37.5 hours per week, excellent rates of pay = £14.40 per hour. 25 days annual leave plus any bank holidays worked. 8 week rolling rota (issued 2 months in advance). Excellent training opportunities. A great work environment with a fantastic team.
If successful, the candidate will need to have a DBS check completed by Viva Heights and two satisfactory references prior to starting work. A full induction will be given and a period of shadowing will be offered and form part of a 6 month probation period.
Please email Helen Millar on managervivaheights@vivavest.uk with a copy of your CV and to request an application form.

Able Homecare Limited is looking to recruit caring, compassionate, and reliable individuals to join our team as Overnight Community Support Workers. This rewarding role involves providing support to adults within their own homes during the night, helping them to remain safe, comfortable, and independent. Duties may include assisting with personal care, supporting mobility, administering or prompting medication where required, monitoring wellbeing, responding to individual needs, and providing reassurance and companionship.

We are seeking individuals who have excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and a genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others. Previous care experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training and ongoing support will be provided. Applicants should be able to work independently, demonstrate reliability and professionalism, and be committed to delivering high-quality person-centred care.

In return, we offer competitive rates of pay, opportunities for career development and the opportunity to be part of a supportive and dedicated team.

Successful applicants will be subject to satisfactory references and an Enhanced DBS check.

Notes
The Bar Worker is responsible for delivering friendly, efficient service to customers while preparing and serving drinks to company standards. The role supports a clean, safe, and welcoming pub environment.

We’re looking for friendly and reliable people to join our bar teams across various Heron & Brearley pubs on the island. We have roles available in both wet-led pubs and pubs that also serve food. No experience is needed as full training is provided. 

Applicants must be 18 or over due to alcohol service.

What the job involves:

Serving drinks and looking after customers.
Supporting food service where required.
Keeping the bar area clean and safe.
Handling payments and using tills.
Working as part of a team during busy shifts. 
Working hours. 

Shift work, including evenings and weekends. Hours vary by site.

What we’re looking for:

Friendly and approachable attitude.
Good communication skills.
Reliability and good timekeeping.
Ability to stay calm when it’s busy.
Willingness to learn and help out where needed. 
Training provided. 

You’ll receive full training in bar service, customer service, responsible alcohol service, and food hygiene where relevant.

Locations: 

Positions are available across multiple Heron & Brearley pubs around the Isle of Man.

To Apply follow this link: https://careers.hb.im/job/bar-worker-5843912?source=hb.im - Applications via email will not be accepted.

Notes
We are looking for a passionate, forward-thinking full-time Chef/Cook to work alongside our Head Chef at Vibe, a multi award-winning plant based café and restaurant in Douglas. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is genuinely passionate about food, creativity, seasonality and plant based cooking, and who wants to further their career in a kitchen where innovation, freedom and customer connection are at the heart of everything we do.

Our Head Chef is a double award-winning plant based chef, winning the Isle of Man Manx Menu award two years running, alongside accolades for innovation and creativity. We want someone to join the team who is excited and passionate about what can be achieved with plant based food. 

By day, Vibe is a vibrant café serving creative brunches & nourishing lunches. You will use the mornings to check in deliveries, prepare dish ingredients from scratch, cook from recipes and set up the kitchen for service, then cook to order during Lunch service. We close for a break then reopen for dinner. Afternoons are for prep and restocking. By night, the café transforms into an intimate restaurant space offering a seasonal small plates menu designed for a relaxed tapas-style dining experience. Dishes are made fresh to order and fired out throughout the evening, allowing guests to build their own tasting menu experience and enjoy food at their own pace. Closed Sunday evenings, Mondays and Tuesdays. 

Our menus change every two months and are heavily inspired by the seasons, local produce and foraged ingredients. We are passionate about pickling, fermenting, dehydrating and preserving ingredients throughout the year to maximise flavour and minimise waste. We work closely with local farms and growers, and we are incredibly lucky to also have our own rooftop garden filled with edible flowers, herbs and fresh ingredients used throughout our food and cocktail menus.

THE ROLE
We are looking for someone who:
Has a genuine passion for plant based food and modern cooking. Is creative, enthusiastic and career driven. Is consistent, has attention to detail and good plating presentation skills. Loves working with seasonal ingredients and flavour-led cooking. Is organised, fast and confident working unsupervised. Can confidently manage their own prep and service section. Thrives in a small close-knit team environment. Is willing to work split shifts. Wants to contribute ideas and continue learning and evolving.

This is a multitasking role within a very small and intimate kitchen team. We are looking for someone who understands that small independent hospitality is hard work but incredibly rewarding. None of us are afraid of getting our hands dirty and doing whatever needs to be done to achieve our goals. Chefs are responsible for washing their own utensils and pots during service and the front of house handles the containers, boards and dishwasher support throughout the day. 
To apply send us your CV and cover letter to hello@vibecafe.im

Notes
We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island.

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role:
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
What You'll Be Doing:
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You:
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer:
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply:
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im

Notes
We are delighted to announce an exciting internal opportunity for an Events Supervisor to join our Food & Beverage team at Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.

This role is ideal for a motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about delivering exceptional guest experiences and has a strong interest in weddings, conferences, corporate functions, and special events.

Position Details:

Job Title: Events Supervisor.
Department: Food & Beverage.
Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent.
Start Date: As soon as possible.

About the Role:

As Events Supervisor, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of weddings, conferences, corporate events, and private functions across the resort. You will support the Events and F&B management teams by leading service operations, coordinating event execution, and ensuring our guests receive outstanding service at every stage of their event.

Key Responsibilities:

Supervise and lead event service teams during weddings, conferences, and other functions.
Ensure events are delivered efficiently and to the highest service standards.
Assist with event set-up, room preparation, and operational planning.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure seamless event delivery.
Act as a point of contact for clients and suppliers during events.
Support the training, development, and motivation of team members.
Maintain exceptional guest satisfaction and promptly resolve any operational issues.

Skills and Experience:

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate:

Previous supervisory experience within hospitality, events, food and beverage, or a customer-focused environment.
Excellent communication and organisational skills.
Strong leadership abilities and a positive, proactive attitude.
The ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required by the business.
A commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career within Comis Hotel & Golf Resort, gain valuable leadership experience, and contribute to some of the Island's most prestigious events and celebrations.

How to Apply:

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your expression of interest and an up-to-date CV to hr@comishotel.com.

Experience with Internet Banking (.NET), iOS and Android mobile apps, Microsoft Dynamics 365. Proficiency with Power Platform and RPA tooling for automation solutions. Experience acting as an Application SME with deep understanding of system architecture. Knowledge of integrations, data flows, dependencies and system limitations. Experience designing event-driven data solutions and configuring Kafka topics. Proven ability to translate business requirements into clear technical designs.Experience as the specialist for third-party SaaS and low-code tools driving adoption. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to recommend secure, scalable solutions. Experience modernising legacy technologies with supported enterprise solutions (desirable). Exposure to Java or Python in context of event streaming or API integration (desirable). Familiarity with data visualisation, dashboards or AI-enabled tooling (desirable).

Identify and pursue new business opportunities in target industries.
Generate qualified leads through networking, referrals, events, and outbound outreach.
Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
2. Client Relationship Management. 
Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing clients.
Understand client business challenges and recommend suitable AI solutions.
Conduct regular meetings, presentations, and follow-ups with stakeholders.
Ensure high customer satisfaction and long-term account retention.
3. AI Solution Consulting. 
Learn and communicate the company's AI products, platforms, and services effectively.
Translate technical AI capabilities into business value for customers.
Work closely with technical teams to create customized proposals and demonstrations.
Educate clients on AI use cases, ROI, and implementation benefits.
4. Market Research & Competitive Analysis. 
Monitor AI industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor activities.
Identify new market segments and growth opportunities.
Gather customer feedback to help shape product strategy.

Prepare business proposals, quotations, RFP/RFQ responses, and presentations.
Lead contract negotiations and pricing discussions.
Coordinate with legal and finance teams during deal closure.
6. Strategic Partnerships. 
Develop partnerships with technology providers, system integrators, consulting firms, and channel partners.
Identify collaboration opportunities that enhance market reach.
Manage alliance relationships and joint business initiatives.

Work with product, engineering, marketing, and customer success teams.
Provide market intelligence and customer insights.
Support product launches and go-to-market strategies.

Prepare revenue forecasts and pipeline reports for management.
Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and sales metrics.

New revenue generated.

Number of qualified leads generated.
Conversion rate.
Customer acquisition cost (CAC).
Customer retention rate.
Average deal size.
Partnership revenue contribution.

Business development and B2B sales experience.
Understanding of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and SaaS business models.
Strong negotiation and presentation skills.
CRM tools knowledge (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
Market research and strategic planning.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Proposal writing and contract negotiation.

Notes
Our client seeks a Transaction Management Unit Manager to join their team. Role Profile: To independently implement and manage a range of complex Structured Corporate Loan transactions as intended by the loan agreement, in support of the IB business and Wholesale Clients clients. Key Responsibilities: Actively monitor, identify, investigate, resolve and / or escalate complex issues relating to the deal throughout the life of each live transaction and regularly communicate with stakeholders in order to maintain appropriate positions and efficient operations, ensure the transaction terms and conditions are adhered to by the client and / or third parties, provide a high-quality service, and mitigate operational risk. Collect and lodge all transaction collateral documentation (e.g. legal agreements, security agreements, share certificates) with the Collateral team for safe keeping and feed downstream calculations for capital management and credit risk mitigation. Coordinate with Legal, Credit and Collateral to approve and authorise various collateral (security) releases. Consult stakeholders, provide relevant operational expertise regarding complex Structured Loan transaction operational requirements into cross-functional enablement teams, provide approvals and participate in post product deployment reviews, to ensure the effective operation of new product development and smooth activations. Coordinate and inform stakeholders of the transaction close out when it reaches maturity, to ensure stakeholders are aligned, Wholesale Clients records are reliable and valid, and the capital management process is well supported. Where applicable, provide instructions to release all required collateral. Create complex transactions based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Educated to Degree Level (Business Commerce). 5 - 7 years experience in Operations. A track record adding value and delivering professional, client centric service to internal and /or external clients preferred. Experience working within Transaction Management in Financial Services supporting the Investment Banking business.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16599

Notes
Job Purpose:	
We’re looking for a confident Digital Marketing Executive that will take the reins of key marketing activity across partner, customer and internal comms for a 12-month fixed term role, helping shape how plan.com shows up in the market every day.

This role is all about turning ideas into impact. From campaigns and content to product launches and partner activity, you’ll be right at the centre of making things happen - creating marketing that gets seen, used and talked about. The ideal candidate will have experience in a high-pace, competitive environment, with the passion and drive to deliver multiple projects often to tight deadlines. A creative and strategic thinker, you’ll have the energy and drive to go the extra mile and exceed expectations.

Working closely with sales, product, design, people experience and senior leaders, you’ll take business priorities and turn them into clear, creative and commercially focused marketing across every channel. It’s a hands-on role where no two days look the same - one minute you’re shaping a campaign, the next you’re pulling together a launch, writing content, or bringing a new idea to life.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Partner Marketing:
Responsible for the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns to engage audiences and set plan.com apart. 
Lead partner marketing campaigns and enablement activity. 
Develop and maintain sales collateral, partner tools and presentation.
Create partner training materials and enablement content.
Support development of case studies and testimonials.
Coordinate partner webinar communications and setup.

Campaign & Content Delivery:
Plan and deliver marketing campaigns across email, web and digital channels.
Develop and manage end-to-end marketing launch plans for products, services, and platform updates.
Manage customer lifecycle communications including onboarding, service updates, and change communications (from copy through to delivery).

Internal Marketing & Brand:
Ensure brand and messaging consistency across all channels.
Coordinate internal launch planning and go-to-market activity.
Support sales teams with battlecards, messaging, and pitch content.
Coordinate the advertising and PR efforts of the businesses.
Coordinate marketing briefs with internal teams and external agencies (design and PR) where required.
Support maintenance of sales SRM onboarding and data coordination.

Full details of role & how to apply at - www.plan.com/careers

The Senior Security Operations Engineer is responsible for setting the strategic direction of plan.com’s defensive security capability while remaining deeply hands-on across the organisation’s security tooling and day-to-day operations. Building on the foundations established by the Security Operations (Blue Team) function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of security operations at plan.com, defining the vision, architecture, and roadmap that will mature our cyber security posture from endpoint to network edge. This role combines threat detection, monitoring, and incident investigation with the leadership required to build processes, select and integrate tooling, and embed a security-first culture throughout the organisation. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for cyber security, mentoring colleagues, advising executive leadership on cyber risk, and collaborating with internal and external teams across a broad range of ecosystems to ensure organisation-wide adherence to security best practices and conformity to regulatory obligations pertaining to cybersecurity.

An opportunity for a seasoned audit professional ready to step into a Director-level role and take genuine ownership of a Financial Services Audit practice on the Isle of Man. This is a rare chance to lead from the front, combining strategic practice development with hands-on client leadership across a prestigious and varied portfolio spanning banking, insurance, funds and other regulated financial services sectors. You will be the trusted advisor of choice for Boards, Audit Committees and Senior Management teams, overseeing the end-to-end delivery of complex audit engagements to the highest professional standards whilst ensuring full compliance with ISA, IFRS and UK GAAP requirements. Equally important will be your ability to drive commercial growth, identify new business opportunities, lead pitches and proposals, expand existing client relationships and contribute meaningfully to fee negotiations and portfolio development. You will inspire and develop a talented audit team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability and continuous improvement, and playing an active role in succession planning and talent development across the practice. Collaboration will be key, working across advisory and tax service lines and representing the business at industry events and within the wider Isle of Man financial services community. Our client seeks a Management Accountant to join their Finance Team. Role Profile: You In this role, you'll play a key part in supporting the financial health and strategic direction of the Group. You'll contribute to the delivery of accurate, insightful financial reporting and analysis, helping to inform decision-making and drive performance across the Group. Joining the bank and its mission to provide financial excellence by monitoring performance, managing costs, assessing risks, and delivering strategic insights that drive informed decision-making. You'll report to the Head of Management Accounting and the Group Financial Controller, supporting the Finance Director and wider Finance Team in delivering accurate financial reporting and analysis across the Group. Key Responsibilities: Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts the bank and its subsidiaries. Support financial reporting with journal entries, reconciliations, VAT and tax filings, and management pack preparation. Drive continuous improvement in reporting through KPIs, variance analysis, and trend insights. Collaborate with teams across the business, respond to financial queries, and support team development. Provide cover for senior finance roles and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Key Skills and Experience: A recognised accountant qualification, be part-qualified, or have relevant industry experience. Knowledge of IFRS, UK Accounting Standards, and ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero). Working knowledge of relational database theory sufficient to perform database queries. Excellent Excel and numeracy skills. Strong organisation and communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. All applications will be treated with the utmost discretion.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16434

Experienced Project Manager.

Project Management, Groundworks, Drainage & Site Liaison.

About the Role:

You’ll be the go-to person across multiple sites, managing crews, keeping clients happy and making sure work gets measured, recorded and signed off properly. Day-to-day, you’ll be attending site meetings, liaising with our site managers, overseeing groundwork teams and working closely with the QS to verify completed work. It’s hands-on, varied and you’ll need to confidently juggle several projects at once.

You’ve got solid experience in groundwork or drainage project management - not necessarily years in the role, but you understand how sites operate, you’re comfortable handling conversations with both staff and clients and you’re organised enough to keep projects moving and problems solved.

DGC is a tight-knit, growing team delivering a real variety of work across the island. We take pride in running clean, well-organised and tightly managed sites, with a strong focus on health, safety and high standards of workmanship. You’ll be working alongside experienced site managers and crews who know their stuff. We look after our people, and if you’re relocating from the UK, we can help sort accommodation.

Requirements:

Proven experience managing groundwork or drainage projects on-site. Demonstrable experience liaising with clients and managing site teams. Valid driving licence. Health & Safety awareness and site-specific inductions.

Location:
Isle of Man.

Salary:
Competitive.

For more details and to apply contact info@dgc.im

Ready to make a real difference — and have fun doing it? We're on the lookout for a talented fundraiser to join our clients small but mighty team and help take it to the next level.
The role:
This isn't a behind-the-desk job. You'll be right in the mix — developing the fundraising and marketing strategy, writing bids, chasing down new income opportunities, building relationships with corporates and funders, and making sure the world knows what they do and why it matters. You'll also manage the Events & Engagement Officer and a team of volunteers, so there's real variety to the work.
What we need from you:
You've got a solid track record of bringing in serious money — we're talking five and six-figure grants, partnerships, and tenders — ideally in a charity or community setting. You're the kind of person who can think big picture one minute and get stuck into the detail the next. You're great with people, confident representing an organisation externally, and you know your way around digital fundraising, social media, and tools like Canva and WordPress.
A full driving licence is essential, and you'll need to be flexible about hours from time to time.

For full details email your CV to info@ambitions.co.im stating the role you are applying for

Notes
Altenar is a leading IT company founded in 2011 and headquartered in the Isle of Man, with offices in Malta, Greece, Georgia, Brazil and Uruguay.
We are seeking a proactive and detail oriented Junior Legal/Contracts Officer to support the legal, contracts, and governance functions of the business.
Key Responsibilities:
Assisting with the corporate governance of the Altenar group of Companies, including arranging board meetings and preparing agendas and board packs.
Assisting with the creation and preparation of documents for presentation to the Board of Directors for review and signature, particularly customer onboarding documentation.
Attending board meetings to assist with the recording and preparation of accurate board minutes.
Working with the Contracts Manager to ensure legal documents progress efficiently from drafting and collaboration (with all relevant stakeholders) through negotiation to  execution.
Ensuring physical and electronic filing is completed promptly and accurately, including  maintaining internal document databases and records.
Assisting the Compliance department with customer and supplier on-boarding processes.
Supporting general company administration, including insurance and data protection renewals and other corporate administrative requirements as they  arise. 
Assisting with banking administration and payment processes, as required.
Providing general administrative and ad-hoc business support as required from time to time.

Essential Requirements:
Good standard of general education, including GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities.
Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
Proactive and self motivated approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
Willingness and aptitude to learn new processes, systems, and areas of the business.
Ability to follow instruction carefully while also using initiative and sound judgement

Desirable Requirements:
Previous experience in an administrative, governance, legal support, compliance or company secretarial role, including exposure to board meetings or governance processes
Experience working within a regulated industry or professional services environment.
Familiarity with legal documentation, contracts administration, or compliance processes.
Experience maintaining document management systems or internal databases.
Understanding of customer and supplier onboarding processes.
Knowledge of data protection requirements and general corporate administration.

For more details and to apply contact job@altenar.com

Notes
Branch Administrator.

The Branch Administrator plays a key role in the success of our branch, supporting the smooth running of day-to-day operations behind the scenes and helping us deliver a strong customer-first experience.
This role connects teams across the branch, head office and our customers, so building positive and respectful working relationships is important. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels supported, valued and able to contribute.

What will I be doing?
Managing customer accounts to ensure they are accurate and up to date. 
Ensuring the trading system is maintained accurately for stock inwards, inter-branch transfers and purchase orders. 
Maintaining paperwork and processes to support compliance with audit requirements. 
Supporting efficient use of resources within the branch. 
Helping the branch deliver a positive and consistent customer experience. 
Assisting with branch stock takes. 
Responding to incoming enquiries, such as proof of delivery requests. 
Advising customers on payment methods and account options .
Resolving invoice queries in a timely and professional manner, working with the credit control team where needed. 
Supporting colleagues on the trade counter or shop floor during busy periods. 
Carrying out any other reasonable duties to support the wider team and business.

What do we need from you?
Experience in an administrative or office-based role. 
Experience responding to queries in a professional and respectful way. 
A proactive and organised approach, with good attention to detail. 
Strong communication skills across face-to-face, phone and written interactions. 
A collaborative approach and willingness to build positive relationships with colleagues and customers. 
We recognise that people gain skills and experience in different ways, so if you feel you meet most of the criteria, we would still encourage you to apply.

Desirable (not essential):
If we receive a high number of applications, the following may be used to support shortlisting:
Experience in a similar financially focused administration role. 
Some knowledge of the building or construction industry.

Our commitment to inclusion:
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and we aim to provide a fair and accessible recruitment process.
If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know and we will support you where we can.

For more details and to apply contact hannah.quirey@jpcorry.co.uk

Experience in bank processes, products and systems. Experience in dealing with different stakeholders at different levels both internal and external. Experience in the realm of Anti-Fraud, Anti-Bribery, Anti-Market Abuse, Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting Financing of Terrorism Surveillance, Analytics and Investigation. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and identify patterns. Excellent communication skills and attention to detail. Knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements.

Our client seeks a Financial Crime Analyst to join their team. Role Profile: To conduct surveillance, analyse and investigate customers with respect to potential terrorist financing and money laundering related to bribery, corruption, another predicate offences or other suspicious activity, based on System and Manual Alerts. This is essential in order to contribute to the assurance that business is undertaken in a compliant manner to avoid operational losses, fines, penalties or reputational damage to the organisation. Key Responsibilities: Analyse alerts (System, Manual, Regulatory, Remittance Platform & Excon Alerts) to identify suspicious activities relating to money laundering & terrorist financing. Assess the independent risk profiles of clients as a second line-of-defence, in relation to consequential risks. Conduct in-depth research and perform data analytics to identify patterns and trends consistent with money laundering, terror financing, and other types of suspicious activity. Analyse all information related to alerts and/or instructions received to detect possible money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, and exchange control contraventions. Analyse all matters relating to high-risk customers containing adverse information, escalating complex and significant issues to line management. Capture findings and conclusions in the required reporting format and systems and prepare outcomes as prescribed by relevant policies and procedures. Collaborate with the Financial Intelligence Centre to address large scale or sensitive financial crimes. Key Skills and Experience: National Certificate in Internal Audit (minimum qualification). 3-4 years' experience in Compliance within the financial services sector. Experience in bank processes, products and systems. Experience in dealing with different stakeholders at different levels both internal and external. Experience in the realm of Anti-Fraud, Anti-Bribery, Anti-Market Abuse, Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting Financing of Terrorism Surveillance, Analytics and Investigation. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and identify patterns. Excellent communication skills and attention to detail. Knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements.

Notes
Our client seeks an experienced Group Compliance Officer to join their team and take senior compliance and financial crime accountability across the group's regulated entities. Subject to regulatory approval, this is a hands-on, senior position with direct ownership of the regulatory relationship with both the UK FCA and the IOM FSA, and a defining role in shaping the group's compliance framework as their fund platform widens. Key Responsibilities: Discharge statutory Compliance Officer role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Maintain compliance monitoring programmes, regulatory returns, and statutory registers. Oversee SMF16 Compliance Oversight function, with ownership of AIFMD, MIFIDPRU, MAR, SYSC, and COBS compliance. Lead FCA supervisory dialogue, regulatory returns and notifications including AIFMD Annex IV reports. Hold MLRO function, managing group sanctions screening and customer due diligence. Run group AML/CFT programmes with particular attention to maritime risk factors. Provide regulatory advice on existing and new fund vehicles across multiple jurisdictions. Embed strong compliance culture across London, Isle of Man, Cyprus and Geneva operations. Report to relevant boards and committees on compliance and financial crime risk matters. Key Skills and Experience: Minimum three years compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as ICA Diploma in Compliance or CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance. Strong working knowledge of FCA rules relevant to full-scope AIFMs including AIFMD, MIFIDPRU, MAR, SYSC, COBS. Direct prior experience as MLRO at a corporate service provider or comparable regulated entity would be desirable. maritime, shipping or commodities sector experience would be ideal. Evidence of ability to satisfy FCA fitness and propriety standards for SMF16 approval.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16553
