About the Role:
Our Helpdesk Team is at the centre of our operations, ensuring effective communication between clients and engineers while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery. As a Service Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting our Engineering Teams by coordinating both reactive and planned maintenance activities, helping to ensure a seamless and efficient service for our clients.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing incoming calls and emails, liaising with clients and engineers, and coordinating maintenance schedules to ensure works are completed efficiently and within agreed timescales. You will create, track, and close work orders using both internal and external CAFM systems, while also preparing, analysing, and distributing job reports and associated paperwork. In addition, you will support wider business operations by progressing quotes, orders, and general administrative tasks as required, whilst maintaining awareness of SLAs, KPIs, and risk management best practices.

To succeed in this role, you will need strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and database management systems. Excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage and process data accurately are essential. We are looking for someone with a proactive attitude who is keen to learn new systems and processes and can work effectively within a fast-paced environment.

Previous experience within facilities management or a related industry would be advantageous, as would an understanding of Health and Safety practices and procedures.

In return, we offer a competitive salary, a supportive and professional working environment, pension scheme, private healthcare, and continued training and long-term professional development opportunities through Prospero Group.

How to apply? Please send your CV to hr@prospero.im

Notes
Our client seeks a talented Data/BI Analyst to join their team for a 12-month contract. You'll play a key role in transforming data into meaningful business insights. You'll work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to understand business challenges, build impactful dashboards and reports, and develop data-driven solutions that support strategic decision-making. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with business engagement. You'll be responsible for data modelling, data quality management, reporting and analytics, while helping to build and enhance the organisation's data capabilities. Key Responsibilities: Establish and manage key data management competencies such as data quality assurance, metadata management, master data management, and data modelling. Support data governance and control frameworks to maintain data quality and data integrity. Document and maintain source-to-target mappings, data flows, and data definitions. Design and facilitate user self-service of tactical data requests and report working with data analysts and business users. Engage with business stakeholders to understand their requirements, translating these into actionable data insights, dashboards, and reports. Re-engineer manual data flows for scalability and improved efficiency in reporting, working with other departments. Build the advanced analytics capability using tools such as Python, PySpark, Machine Learning utilising statistical data techniques. Monitor team workflows, resource allocation, and project progress, while ensuring team members' professional development through training and development. Key Skills and Experience: Proven experience in a Data Analyst/Business Analyst (data focused), or similar role. Data modelling experience. Advanced data visualisation and report creation skills (Power BI reports and dashboards). Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Data cleansing and data enrichment experience. Advanced knowledge of SQL data queries and joins. Knowledge and experience in data governance. Excellent communication skills, communicating between technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16584

We are seeking a commercially driven Business Development and Marketing Manager to join our Marketing, Sales and Business Delivery team.
In this dynamic, dual-focused role, you will play a key part in delivering FIM’s growth strategy - driving brand visibility, strengthening client relationships, and generating new business opportunities. You will sit at the intersection of marketing and business development, shaping how we engage with clients and position ourselves in the market.

Your duties will include:
Delivering targeted marketing campaigns to support business growth.
Managing brand, PR, content, and external agency relationships.
Driving new business opportunities through strategic partnerships and outreach.
Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, intermediaries, and key stakeholders.
Planning and delivering events, sponsorships, and client engagement initiatives.
Managing digital channels including our company website and CRM to enhance the client journey and increase brand presence, including providing supporting data.
Monitoring market trends, competitor activity, and campaign performance to identify opportunities.

About you:
A commercially minded professional with a strong track record in business development and/or marketing.
Confident relationship builder with excellent communication and influencing skills.
Results-driven, with the ability to identify opportunities and convert them into tangible outcomes.
Strategic and creative thinker with strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Have a working knowledge of design principles and experience producing effective marketing materials.
Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams.
Passionate about delivering high-quality client experiences and building lasting relationships.
Experience within investments, financial services or a similar professional environment.
Willingness and ability to undertake off-island business travel as required.

Why join us?
This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in FIM’s continued growth by helping to shape our brand, expand our reach, and make a real impact on our commercial success.

Apply now!
To apply, please email a copy of your current cv to our HR team at hr@fim.co.im, or visit our careers page for more info: https://www.fimcapital.co.im/careers.

The schedule consists of 16 flexible hours to be completed between Monday and Friday, preferably 09:00 - 13.00. Candidates must possess a full, clean driving licence. Key Responsibilities: Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies for business development, creating and pursuing new leads. Acting as a point of contact for customers throughout the sales cycle. Presenting products or services clearly and confidently. Preparing proposals, estimates and Agreements and any other necessary key documents. Negotiating pricing and terms in line with company guidelines. Assist with the implementation of new processes and procedures when efficiencies are identified. Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience working in a technical environment. Proven ability to sell products and services. Resilience and the ability to stay focused during challenging conversations. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships. Self-motivation and a proactive approach to meeting goals. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Confident presentation and negotiation skills. Good administration skills and attention to detail.

Our client, a long established fiduciary services business, is seeking a senior individual to take responsibility for its client administration function. The role sits at senior level within the organisation and combines operational oversight, team coordination and direct involvement in complex fiduciary client matters. The focus is on maintaining high service standards, ensuring regulatory obligations are met and supporting the effective running of the function. Key Responsibilities: Oversee day-to-day fiduciary administration activity, ensuring workloads are prioritised and deadlines consistently achieved. Take responsibility for a small portfolio of trust and company structures, including more complex or sensitive arrangements. Act as escalation point for technical fiduciary matters requiring experience and sound judgement. Maintain oversight of client review cycles, periodic compliance activity and associated deadlines. Monitor debtor balances and broader operational risk indicators, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution. Review and interpret management information relating to workload, performance and client activity. Support senior stakeholders with operational planning and client-related matters as required. Contribute to the refinement of internal processes, controls and procedural consistency. Provide day-to-day structure across a small administration team, supporting clarity of expectations and delivery standards. Assist with development of team capability through feedback, guidance and on the job support. Maintain effective working relationships with clients, intermediaries and other stakeholders. Key Skills and Experience: Significant experience in fiduciary administration within trust and company services. Strong technical understanding of trust and corporate structures and relevant regulatory frameworks. Previous experience in a supervisory, senior leadership position. Comfortable managing complex fiduciary matters and working under regulatory scrutiny. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a structured way. Clear, practical communicator with a professional and commercially aware approach. Additional Requirements: STEP, CGI/ICSA or equivalent professional qualification would be beneficial but is not essential. Solid experience working within Isle of Man fiduciary regulatory and governance environments. Confident user of standard administration and reporting systems.

Our client seeks a Senior Company Administrator to join their team. Key Responsibilities: Ensuring the smooth running of the board's activities by helping to set agendas, drafting board minutes/resolutions, preparing and presenting papers and advising on board procedures. Assisting with transactional monitoring reporting, admin reviews, risk reviews, and client review assessments to ensure compliance with anti-money laundering regulations and other relevant compliance in co-operation with the compliance department. Assisting with third-party contract management by risk screening the parties in advance of any agreed commercial arrangements, collecting, and reviewing company documentation to identify any potential risks, maintaining internal records. Assisting the board of client entities in the general management of the entities, collating statutory and due diligence client entity packs as and when requested. Ensuring correct entry and administration of client entity data in the internal database, which will include reviewing/updating the client entity files. Provide payment inputting cover to ensure the client entities can run operationally following the internal payment procedures which may include carrying out callbacks on new payees, inputting payment on multiple banking platforms. Assisting with compliance with all statutory filing. Key Skills and Experience: Proven experience Company administration experience. A high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to deliver quality and timely results, working under pressure and to tight deadlines. Able to take accountability and responsibility for own personal development. Highly motivated in providing exceptional levels of service. Self-confident and an able speaker with excellent interpersonal skills. Strong organisational skills, flexibility and logic. Able to work confidently alone as well as being able to work as part of a team. Competent in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook. Desirable: A working knowledge of the e-gaming industry. Experience of Viewpoint administration system. STEP qualified or working towards a relevant qualification would be desirable.

Notes
Are you someone who enjoys hands-on work, thrives in a laboratory environment, and takes pride in doing things with accuracy and care? We’re looking for a Production Technician to join our team and play a key role in manufacturing high-quality chromatography products that support important scientific and commercial outcomes.

This is more than just a production role — it’s an opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement, process optimisation, and innovation in a regulated, high-performing environment.
This role will be a Fixed Term Contract.
You’ll be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure our products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Your responsibilities will include - Manufacturing chromatography products, intermediates, and base materials - Following established SOPs and production methods with precision - Recording production data accurately and maintaining detailed documentation - Carrying out on-line quality control checks and identifying any anomalies early - Supporting process optimisation and improvement initiatives - Maintaining equipment and ensuring a clean, safe working environment. 
You’ll also contribute to - Improving processes and maximising yields - Writing and updating SOPs and production methods - Sharing knowledge and supporting the development of colleagues. 
We’re looking for someone who is practical, detail-focused, and proactive, with a genuine interest in laboratory-based manufacturing.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are - A strong team player with good communication skills - Highly organised with excellent attention to detail - 
Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team - A natural problem solver who can spot issues early - Able to follow processes accurately while also contributing ideas for improvement. 
Desirable experience - Degree in a scientific discipline - Experience in regulated manufacturing (ideally chemical or similar environments) - Familiarity with laboratory equipment and processes. 
This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role where no two days are quite the same. You can expect - A physically active role involving standing, lifting, and equipment operation - A structured environment with a strong focus on quality and safety - 24/7 shift patterns supporting continuous operations
To Apply please follow this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/7453461-production-chemist-astrea-bioseparations-fixed-term-contract

Concept Development - collaborate with designers to translate initial sketches and ideas into feasible products.
Conduct research and be proactive in suggesting possible development to client.
Material Sourcing - work with suppliers to buy yarn and negotiate prices. 
Technical Development - ensure that the tech packs are clear and comprehensive for Albion to follow.
Collaborate with the Stoll Programming Team on all product development sent by clients, ensuring all requirements are understood and acted upon.
Create costing sheets to determine pricing for clients. Analyse product costs and work to keep them within budget while maintaining quality.
Oversee product checks during the development, pre-production, and bulk production stages to ensure client specifications are met.
Ensure all necessary information for client invoicing is provided to the finance department promptly for timely invoicing.
Create comprehensive range plans, including pictures, yarn details, garment weight, gauge, machine, total quantity ordered, and any other relevant information.
Order all necessary items listed on the Bill of Materials (BOMs) according to client requirements.
Liaise with yarn suppliers to obtain yarn prices, sample yarn, and bulk yarn.
Communicate any potential intellectual property (I.P.) infringements to the production staff.
Take receipt of and distribute all client Purchase Contracts and Purchase Order forms to relevant internal staff.
Issue production instructions to the manufacturing departments.
Communicate specific packing requirements from clients to the packing department.
Stay up to date with yarn and knitwear trends and relay this information to clients during meetings.
Create development swatches and prototypes to present to clients to generate additional business.
Handle general administration duties required for all launches, including record-keeping, mainly using Excel.
For more details and to apply contact rippal@albionknit.com

Notes
Job Description: Panel Inspector.
Job Purpose:
To inspect knitted panels during and after production to ensure they meet the required quality standards and customer specifications before progressing to the linking and garment assembly stages.
Key Responsibilities:
Inspect knitted panels for faults, defects, and inconsistencies.
Check panel measurements against approved specifications and size charts.
Identify knitting defects such as holes, dropped stitches, yarn contamination, oil stains, uneven tension, and colour variations.
Ensure panels are correctly matched for shade, size, and style.
Separate and record defective panels and report issues to the Knitting Supervisor or Quality Manager.
Maintain accurate inspection records and production documentation.
Work closely with knitting, linking, and finishing departments to resolve quality issues.
Ensure all products comply with company quality standards and customer requirements.
Follow health and safety procedures and maintain a clean and organised work area.
Assist with continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and improve production efficiency.

Skills and Experience:
Previous experience in knitwear manufacturing or textile inspection is preferred.
Good understanding of knitted garment construction and quality standards.
Ability to identify knitting and yarn defects.
Good attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Basic record-keeping and communication skills.

For more details and to apply contact rippal@albionknit.com
